mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT CUSTOM_TEAM_ID, USER_ID, TEAM_NAME, FORMATION, CREATED_AT FROM CUSTOM_TEAMS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT S.SQUAD_ID, S.CUSTOM_TEAM_ID, S.PLAYER_ID, NVL(P.NAME_KOR, P.NAME) AS PLAYER_NAME, S.POSITION_NO, S.PITCH_X AS X, S.PITCH_Y AS Y, P.MAIN_POSITION FROM CUSTOM_SQUADS S LEFT JOIN PLAYERS P ON P.PLAYER_ID = S.PLAYER_ID WHERE S.CUSTOM_TEAM_ID = #{customTeamId} ORDER BY S.POSITION_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CUSTOM_TEAMS (USER_ID, TEAM_NAME, FORMATION, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{teamName}, #{formation}, SYSTIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO CUSTOM_SQUADS (CUSTOM_TEAM_ID, PLAYER_ID, POSITION_NO, PITCH_X, PITCH_Y) SELECT #{customTeamId}, #{playerId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{positionNo}, #{x,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{y,jdbcType=NUMERIC} FROM DUAL WHERE #{playerId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PLAYERS WHERE PLAYER_ID = #{playerId,jdbcType=NUMERIC})
INSERT INTO AI_MATCHES (HOME_TEAM_ID, AWAY_TEAM_ID, HOME_SCORE, AWAY_SCORE, AI_REVIEW, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{homeTeamId}, NULL, #{homeScore}, #{awayScore}, #{aiReview}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT ct.USER_ID, ct.CUSTOM_TEAM_ID, ct.TEAM_NAME, u.NICKNAME, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_MATCHES, SUM(CASE WHEN m.HOME_SCORE > m.AWAY_SCORE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WINS, SUM(CASE WHEN m.HOME_SCORE = m.AWAY_SCORE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DRAWS, SUM(CASE WHEN m.HOME_SCORE < m.AWAY_SCORE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LOSSES FROM AI_MATCHES m JOIN CUSTOM_TEAMS ct ON ct.CUSTOM_TEAM_ID = m.HOME_TEAM_ID JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = ct.USER_ID WHERE u.ROLE_CODE != 7 GROUP BY ct.USER_ID, ct.CUSTOM_TEAM_ID, ct.TEAM_NAME, u.NICKNAME ORDER BY WINS DESC, (SUM(CASE WHEN m.HOME_SCORE > m.AWAY_SCORE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) DESC, ct.USER_ID ASC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
